info.title: Sprint 1 Smart Lab and Room Booking API
info.description: Sprint 1 backend with Microsoft Graph one-way creation, rescheduling and cancellation of confirmed bookings. Confirmed events invite the student; room and equipment availability remains managed by the booking system. Outlook credentials must be configured locally; sync status is independent of booking status. University SSO and durable database remain adapter integration points. Recurrence is deferred to Sprint 2. Demo authentication and memory data are local-development-only. All paths retain trailing slashes; request timestamps require offsets and responses use UTC Z. Identity includes university_email. Requests for the same time are first-come-first-served with a waitlist: the first undecided request holds the slot for 30 minutes by default (Manager-configurable per resource); later requests, and a holder whose hold ends while still under review, are WAITLISTED and promoted automatically in order when the slot frees up. Bookings must start at least 7 and at most 30 days ahead (MIN_ADVANCE_DAYS / MAX_ADVANCE_DAYS). Authentication and resource-specific eligibility are separate. Verified induction expires a fixed number of days after approval (QUALIFICATION_VALIDITY_DAYS, default 120, one term); reviewers no longer supply an expiry. Admin and Manager can query the audit trail of requests, approvals, changes and cancellations. The prototype seed has 2 labs and 20 independently bookable devices. A Manager has every Admin permission and can also configure booking policies and nominate user roles or deactivate accounts.

post.summary: Create a room or individual equipment booking request
post.description: Requires a submitted induction for the selected resource. The local start date must be from today + MIN_ADVANCE_DAYS (default 7) to today + MAX_ADVANCE_DAYS (default 30): BOOKING_TOO_SOON / BOOKING_TOO_FAR_AHEAD (400, details.earliest_date, latest_date, min_advance_days, max_advance_days). Requests for the same time are handled first-come-first-served with a waitlist. If no APPROVED booking or active hold overlaps: a valid VERIFIED qualification through the booking end results in APPROVED; PENDING evidence makes this request the slot holder in WAITING_QUALIFICATION (or PENDING_APPROVAL at once if start is within the approval waiting period, default 24 hours) with hold_until = min(start, creation + pending_hold_minutes, default 30). If an APPROVED booking or active hold overlaps, the request becomes WAITLISTED (reason TIME_CONFLICT or TEMPORARY_HOLD_CONFLICT) with waitlist_position, even if qualified. When a hold ends while the holder is still undecided, the holder becomes WAITLISTED (reason HOLD_EXPIRED) and is promoted only once qualified; each request gets at most one hold. When time frees up (cancellation, rejection, expiry, rescheduling, a hold ending, or a waitlisted student's induction being verified) the earliest waitlisted request that now fits is promoted automatically: qualified -> APPROVED; induction under review and never held -> new holder; otherwise REJECTED (QUALIFICATION_REQUIRED); reason PROMOTED_FROM_WAITLIST. A student whose induction is under review may hold at most UNVERIFIED_PENDING_LIMIT (default 1) undecided requests per qualification. Only APPROVED creates an Outlook event. Undecided and waitlisted requests expire at their start time. HTTP 201 alone does not mean approved. Interval semantics are [start, end).

post.description: Admin or Manager only. Qualification and booking decisions are independent. A VERIFIED decision sets valid_until to the review time plus the configured validity period (default 120 days, one term) and re-evaluates the student's WAITING_QUALIFICATION bookings for resources requiring this qualification and approves their waitlisted requests whose time is free. A REJECTED decision requires a reason and rejects all of the student's pending bookings (WAITING_QUALIFICATION and PENDING_APPROVAL) for those resources with reason_code QUALIFICATION_REJECTED and the same reason, releasing their slots at once. updated_bookings lists every booking changed. valid_until is not accepted in the request; sending it returns 400.

post.summary: Approve or reject a booking request
post.description: Admin or Manager only. APPROVED is allowed only for PENDING_APPROVAL requests; it re-checks resource-specific qualification through the booking end and conflicts with APPROVED bookings and active holds, excluding this request's own ID. A WAITLISTED request cannot be approved (REQUEST_WAITLISTED, 409); it is promoted automatically in order. REJECTED (reason required) may be applied to PENDING_APPROVAL or WAITLISTED requests; rejecting a slot holder promotes the next waitlisted request. BOOKING_HOLD_CONFLICT (409) includes details.hold_until; BOOKING_CONFLICT (409) indicates an approved blocker.

get.summary: Audit trail of requests, approvals, changes and cancellations
get.description: Admin or Manager only. Newest first. Filters combine with AND. resource_id matches the resource's own records (for example booking policy changes) and records of its bookings; student_id matches records performed by the student plus records of their bookings, qualification submissions and account. count is the total number of matching records before limit/offset.

patch.summary: Nominate a role or (de)activate an account (Manager only)
patch.description: Active Manager only. Send role and/or active. Takes effect on the user's next request; a deactivated user receives 401. Managers cannot change their own role or status (SELF_MODIFICATION_FORBIDDEN, 403), and at least one active Manager must remain (LAST_MANAGER, 409). Every change writes a USER_UPDATED audit record with previous and new values. Existing bookings are not changed.

403.description: Not an active Manager, or attempting to change yourself.

409.description: LAST_MANAGER: the change would leave no active Manager.

patch.description: Active Manager only; Admin cannot write. Updates persist a per-resource integer from 1 to 20160 minutes (default 30) and an audit entry. Only future holds use the new value; existing deadlines stay unchanged. A longer hold protects the first requester for longer; the maximum effectively holds the slot until the request is decided. Independent of the 24-hour approval waiting period, which only matters when the hold is longer than 24 hours.

BearerAuth.description: Signed demonstration token expires after 3600 seconds. Actual SSO authentication is supplied by a future server-side adapter.

pending_hold_minutes.description: Minutes a newly created first-place pending request holds its slot, capped at the booking start. Default 30. When the hold ends while the request is still undecided, it moves to WAITLISTED (reason HOLD_EXPIRED) and is promoted only once its induction is verified. The maximum 20160 exceeds the booking horizon, which effectively holds the slot until the request is decided.

valid_until.description: Set by the server when VERIFIED: review time plus the configured validity period. Null for PENDING or REJECTED. Bookings must end no later than this time.

effective_status.description: Current derived status, including expiry; the stored review status remains in status.

file_url.description: Private API path; Bearer authentication is still required.

file.description: PDF, PNG or JPEG, at most 5 MiB; validated by the server.

status.description: WAITING_QUALIFICATION and PENDING_APPROVAL are undecided requests that may hold their slot; WAITLISTED is queued behind an earlier booking or request and never holds a slot; only APPROVED is confirmed.

hold_until.description: Historical hold deadline; use hold_active to determine current occupancy.

hold_active.description: Pending status and hold_until strictly later than server time.

blocks_slot.description: True for APPROVED or an undecided request whose hold is active. Never true for WAITLISTED.

waitlist_position.description: 1-based place among waitlisted requests overlapping this one on the same resource, in submission order. Null unless WAITLISTED.

hold_until.description: Latest blocking hold deadline for TEMPORARILY_HELD; otherwise null.

held_by_me.description: True only when all blocking holds belong to the current user.

qualification_status.description: Current resource eligibility; request submission additionally checks validity through the selected end time.

earliest_date.description: First local date a booking may start on (today + MIN_ADVANCE_DAYS).

latest_date.description: Last local date a booking may start on (today + MAX_ADVANCE_DAYS).

sso_connected.description: Always false in Sprint 1; actual school SSO is not integrated.

configured.description: Local configuration exists; does not prove valid Graph authorization.

pending_hold_minutes.description: Minutes a newly created first-place pending request holds its slot, capped at the booking start. Default 30. When the hold ends while the request is still undecided, it moves to WAITLISTED (reason HOLD_EXPIRED) and is promoted only once its induction is verified. The maximum 20160 exceeds the booking horizon, which effectively holds the slot until the request is decided.

action.description: For example BOOKING_CREATED, BOOKING_APPROVED, BOOKING_REJECTED, BOOKING_CANCELLED, BOOKING_RESCHEDULED, BOOKING_REEVALUATED, BOOKING_TIME_PROCESSED, QUALIFICATION_SUBMITTED, QUALIFICATION_VERIFIED, QUALIFICATION_REJECTED, RESOURCE_BOOKING_POLICY_UPDATED, OUTLOOK_SYNC_SUCCEEDED, OUTLOOK_SYNC_FAILED, DEMO_STUDENT_CREATED.
